ns2:section.sectionText: Students should only register for one section of FSHN 120. This in-person section features unique opportunities to engage with speakers and activities specifically developed for Gies College of Business students and Living-Learning Community residents exploring the relationship between business and other fields of practice. *** There will be an opportunity to earn honors credit for James Scholars and Chancellor Scholars. *** For more information, visit https://publish.illinois.edu/nutrition-fshn120/online-vs-in-house/ If you have any questions about the course, feel free to e-mail the lead instructor (Toni Gist) at burkhalt@Illinois.edu
ns2:section.sectionCappArea: Restricted to Business LLC, LEADS LLC, Global Crossroads, Honors LLC, Health Professions Lv Lrn Comm, Intersections, Innovation LLC, Sustainability LLC, Unit One, Weston Explorer Program, or Women in Math/Science/Engr Prg students.
